title: Power Apps: automatic loading and numbered pages in the modern Data Grid
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, paging behaviour, maker settings and existing Power Apps entitlement are supported. The governance checklist names grid properties that are missing from the controls table, a minor completeness finding.

claims.claim: The feature is the modern Data Grid in Power Apps canvas apps.
claims.quote: Makers can configure the modern Data Grid in canvas apps

claims.claim: Makers can configure automatic loading as users scroll.
claims.quote: load more records automatically as users scroll

claims.claim: Makers can configure numbered pages.
claims.quote: or display numbered pages with a configurable page size.

claims.claim: The maker can configure the page size.
claims.quote: display numbered pages with a configurable page size.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Pagination is maker opt-in rather than an automatic change to existing apps.
claims.quote: Existing apps retain their current behavior unless makers enable pagination.

claims.claim: Pagination accepts Pagination.None, Pagination.Auto and Pagination.Number.
claims.quote: Accepts `Pagination.None`, `Pagination.Auto`, or `Pagination.Number`.

claims.claim: Pagination defaults to Pagination.None.
claims.quote: The default is `Pagination.None`.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Scope
claims.claim: Pagination.Auto loads more records from a pageable source as users scroll.
claims.quote: Loads more records from a pageable source as users scroll.

claims.claim: Pagination.Number shows one page with first-page, previous-page and next-page actions.
claims.quote: Shows one page of records with first-page, previous-page, and next-page actions.

claims.claim: PageSize controls the records per fetch or numbered page.
claims.quote: Set **Pagination** to choose how the grid loads and displays records, and **PageSize** to set the number of records per fetch or numbered page.

claims.claim: Blank, zero, negative or invalid PageSize values fall back to 100.
claims.quote: A blank, zero, negative, or invalid value falls back to 100.

claims.claim: Pagination does not bypass delegation limits in Items or make a nondelegable formula delegable.
claims.quote: Turning on pagination doesn't make a nondelegable **Items** formula delegable or retrieve records that aren't in a collection.

claims.claim: Pagination does not bypass connector limits.
claims.quote: Pagination doesn't bypass delegation limits in **Items**, connector limits, or the scope of an already populated collection.

claims.claim: Pagination does not enlarge the scope of an already populated collection.
claims.quote: Pagination doesn't bypass delegation limits in **Items**, connector limits, or the scope of an already populated collection.

claims.claim: Changing Pagination or PageSize clears search text.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn documents Pagination and PageSize but gives no release date or status for them.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Data Grid Pagination automatic loading connector request limits permission role identity release availability. Opened the cited Data Grid article in full; it documents both properties without a release date or status.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Built-in search over a partly loaded source can return incomplete results.
claims.quote: Built-in search over a partly loaded source can return incomplete results. Use a delegable **Items** formula when you need source-wide search.

claims.claim: No matches among loaded records does not prove the remote table has no matches.
claims.quote: A search with no matches among loaded records doesn't prove that the remote table has no matches.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The grid's records come from its Items data source.
claims.quote: **Items** – The data source for the grid. Accepts a Dataverse table, collection, or inline table expression.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The pagination documentation describes no new data source or new data access.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps modern Data Grid Pagination PageSize Searchable DelegateSearch; Power Apps Data Grid Pagination automatic loading connector request limits permission role identity release availability. Opened the Data Grid article; pagination uses Items and does not bypass its limits.

claims.claim: Built-in search checks records the grid has loaded.
claims.quote: When **DelegateSearch** is `false`, search checks the grid's loaded records.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The documented source-wide search procedure sets Searchable to true.
claims.quote: To handle search in Power Fx: 1. Set **Searchable** to `true`.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The documented source-wide search procedure sets DelegateSearch to true.
claims.quote: 2. Set **DelegateSearch** to `true`.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Source-wide search uses the grid's SearchText output in Items with a filter the connector can delegate.
claims.quote: Use the grid's **SearchText** output in **Items** with a filter that your connector can delegate.

claims.claim: The Data Grid article describes no new permission for pagination.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Data Grid Pagination automatic loading connector request limits permission role identity release availability. Opened the Data Grid article in full; pagination has no new permission requirement. Summary permissions concern AI row summaries.

claims.claim: The Data Grid article names no administrator role for pagination.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Data Grid Pagination automatic loading connector request limits permission role identity release availability. Opened the Data Grid article in full; pagination names no administrator role. The administrator prerequisites concern AI row summaries.

claims.claim: The Data Grid article describes no new identity for pagination.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Data Grid Pagination automatic loading connector request limits permission role identity release availability. Opened the Data Grid article in full; its pagination section specifies no new execution identity.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions
claims.claim: The Data Grid article does not describe the effect of automatic loading on connector request limits in a busy app.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Data Grid Pagination automatic loading connector request limits permission role identity release availability. Opened the Data Grid article; it says connector limits still apply but does not quantify automatic loading's request usage or busy-app interaction.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Changing Items rebuilds the paging source.
claims.quote: When the **Items** formula changes, the grid rebuilds its paging source rather than replaying previously completed results.

claims.claim: A page number cannot be relied on after changing Items, Pagination or PageSize.
claims.quote: Changing the paging configuration rebuilds the paging view. Don't depend on a page number remaining unchanged after changing **Items**, **Pagination**, or **PageSize**.

claims.claim: CurrentPage is an output.
claims.quote: **CurrentPage**, **ItemsCount**, and **AllItemsLoaded** are outputs.

claims.claim: ItemsCount is an output.
claims.quote: **CurrentPage**, **ItemsCount**, and **AllItemsLoaded** are outputs.

claims.claim: AllItemsLoaded is an output.
claims.quote: **CurrentPage**, **ItemsCount**, and **AllItemsLoaded** are outputs.

claims.claim: Learn says not to assign formulas to CurrentPage, ItemsCount or AllItemsLoaded.
claims.quote: **CurrentPage**, **ItemsCount**, and **AllItemsLoaded** are outputs. Don't assign formulas to them to implement custom paging.

claims.claim: ItemsCount counts loaded records, not the server-side total.
claims.quote: **ItemsCount** – The number of records currently loaded by the grid, not the total record count in the remote data source and not just the number of rows on the visible page.

claims.claim: Enabling text wrapping on a column disables row virtualization.
claims.quote: If you enable text wrapping on a column, row virtualization is disabled.

claims.claim: The app checker flags columns with text wrapping enabled.
claims.quote: The app checker flags columns with text wrapping enabled.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: This canvas-app option uses the app's existing Power Apps entitlement, represented as included.
claims.quote: Power Apps requires users to have an appropriate license to run apps, in alignment with the premium licensing requirements described in the Microsoft Power Platform Licensing Guide.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Power Apps Premium is one published entitlement option.
claims.quote: **Power Apps Premium** is licensed per user and entitles the licensed user to build, modernize, and run unlimited custom applications

claims.claim: Power Apps requires an appropriate entitlement to run apps.
claims.quote: Power Apps requires users to have an appropriate license to run apps

claims.claim: Power Apps per app is a published licensing option.
claims.quote: **Power Apps per app** enables individual users to run (one custom app or access one Power Pages website) for a specific business scenario based on the full capabilities of Power Apps

claims.claim: Power Apps pay-as-you-go is a published entitlement option.
claims.quote: **Power Apps pay-as-you-go** allows individual users to run applications (one app) without any licenses via an Azure subscription.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No pagination-specific licence is documented in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Data Grid pagination licensing price meter premium. Opened the Data Grid article and both cited licensing FAQs; their pagination/product entitlement passages name no pagination-specific licence.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No pagination-specific price is documented in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Data Grid pagination licensing price meter premium. Opened the Data Grid article and both licensing FAQs; read pay-as-you-go meters search excerpts. Product prices are published, but no separate pagination price was found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No pagination-specific meter is documented in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Data Grid pagination licensing price meter premium. Opened Data Grid and licensing FAQs; read pay-as-you-go meters excerpts. The per-app meter counts unique monthly app users; no pagination-specific meter was found.

claims.claim: The Data Grid article's licence and capacity eligibility checks concern AI row summaries, not pagination.
claims.quote: The canvas grid also checks the shared **AI insight cards** (`EnableFormInsights`) setting and whether AI prompts are enabled. Allowing the canvas-specific feature doesn't override these settings or license and capacity eligibility checks.

claims.claim: Pagination.None makes one nonpageable fetch subject to the app's data row limit.
claims.quote: `Pagination.None` | Makes one nonpageable fetch, subject to the app's data row limit.

claims.claim: Automatic mode displays a collection or inline table's available records rather than simulating incremental remote loading.
claims.quote: For an in-memory table or collection, displays the available records without simulating incremental server loading.

claims.claim: Modern controls and themes are enabled per app in the maker editor at Settings > Updates > New > Modern controls and themes.
claims.quote: With your canvas app open for editing: 1. On the command bar, select **Settings** > **Updates**. 2. Select the **New** tab and then turn on **Modern controls and themes**.

claims.claim: No API that sets the per-app Modern controls and themes toggle is documented in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps "Modern controls and themes" API PowerShell pac canvas app settings; "Modern controls and themes" "Power Platform API" "PowerShell". Opened modern-controls overview, pac canvas and PowerShell support; no operation setting this toggle was found.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The per-app Data row limit for nondelegable processing is at Settings > General > Data row limit in the maker editor.
claims.quote: The default number of records is 500, but you can change this number for your app: 1. Select **Settings**. 2. Under **General**, change the **Data row limit** setting from 1 to 10,000.

claims.claim: No API that sets an app's Data row limit is documented in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps "Data row limit" API PowerShell pac canvas app settings; "Data row limit" "Power Platform API" "PowerShell". Opened delegation overview, pac canvas and PowerShell support; no operation setting this app limit was found.

claims.where: controls[2]; summary; Why it matters; Governance controls; rationale: impact
claims.claim: No tenant or environment pagination switch or pagination-specific administrator configuration requirement is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Data Grid pagination tenant environment administrator disable setting Power Platform API. Opened Data Grid, list-tenantsettings, settings-features and PowerShell support. No pagination switch or required admin action was found; AI summary controls govern a separate feature.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The governance checklist tells makers to choose Pagination and configure Searchable and DelegateSearch, but these controls have no table row.
claims.quote: Checklist: "Have makers choose `Pagination.Auto` or `Pagination.Number` per grid"; "set **Searchable** and **DelegateSearch** to `true`". The table lists only modern controls and themes, Data row limit, and the absent tenant/environment switch.
claims.fix: The At rollout steps for Pagination, Searchable and DelegateSearch have no corresponding controls-table row. Record this coverage gap; do not add control rows as part of this correction.

claims.claim: The modern controls and themes toggle is not documented as a switch over whether pagination is used.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps "Modern controls and themes" API PowerShell pac canvas app settings; Power Apps Data Grid pagination tenant environment administrator disable setting Power Platform API. Opened modern-controls overview and Data Grid; pagination mode is a separate grid property.

claims.claim: Data row limit is an existing per-app query setting rather than the choice of pagination mode.
claims.quote: Set **Pagination** to choose how the grid loads and displays records. Pagination.None: Makes one nonpageable fetch, subject to the app's data row limit.
